content.short: Injective is a highly interoperable layer-1 blockchain in the Cosmos ecosystem.
content.description: Injective is a layer-1 blockchain network and smart contract platform designed for high interoperability with other networks. It includes a decentralized ERC-20 token bridge that makes native Ethereum-based assets usable within its ecosystem, enabling seamless cross-chain value transfer. The Injective Hub serves as the central gateway, bringing together core DeFi capabilities. By connecting to the Injective Hub, DeFi users can perform token swaps, earn staking rewards, and participate in governance proposals, shaping the network's development.
content.meta: Injective is a highly interoperable layer-1 blockchain in the Cosmos ecosystem. Discover Injective and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Trading Perpetual Futures Through an MCP Server
resources.tldr: An MCP server exposing Injective's markets, so an AI agent can place perpetual futures orders from natural language rather than raw calls.

resources.title: Unveiling Injective EVM
resources.tldr: A native EVM layer embedded in the chain's core architecture rather than bolted on, so both environments run against one state.

resources.title: Injective Registers as an SEC Transfer Agent
resources.tldr: Registration with the SEC as a transfer agent, a concrete regulatory step toward handling registered securities onchain.
